class: A dialog taller than the window whose body and buttons scroll together: the confirm button, or the result lines after it (including a warning that the outcome is unknown), can scroll out of view.
mechanism: The modal frame was not bound to the window height.

first_seen.where: 8-order review box on a 1536x639 page area (GC-ICFIX issue 6)
first_seen.evidence: Confirm was pushed off screen; after the first repair the outcome lines, including the ADR-017 outcome-unknown warning, could still scroll out of view.

fix: The shared Modal.vue frame is bound to the window, its body scrolls, the buttons and a status slot are pinned.

detection.note: Unguarded: no named check is confirmed to cover the class; the proof was one real run, not a standing check. Pixels unproven: no screen proof yet (Chrome screenshots time out).

occurrences.where: 8-order review box on a 1536x639 page area (GC-ICFIX issue 6)
occurrences.evidence: Confirm was pushed off screen; after the first repair the outcome lines, including the ADR-017 outcome-unknown warning, could still scroll out of view.
